english.title: Ship not using a mandatory ships' routeing system required for its category / cargo carried
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were

(A)_[the master of]_
(B)_[the owner of]_
(C)_[a person responsible for use of a ship’s routeing system on]_

a ship, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME OF SHIP..), which did not comply with paragraph 7 of regulation 10 of Chapter V in the Annex to the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea 1974 relating to

(D)_[ use of a ship’s routeing system]_
(E)_[such use]_

in that **(..SPECIFY NON-COMPLIANCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 5(2)(b) and 10(2)(a) and (4) of the Merchant Shipping (Safety of Navigation) Regulations 2020.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being the owner / master / other person responsible of a ship
to which the Merchant Shipping (Safety of Navigation) Regulations 2020 applied
contravened the requirements
relating to mandatory ship routeing system
contained in para 7 of regulation 10
of Chapter V in the Annex

Summary: A fine.
Indictment: A fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
